comment_text: It's like my Rancor collection.  Back in the day a shop sold me 500 Urza's Legacy for $70.00.  Over the years I sold a couple of hundred of the lesser quality copies at a dollar a piece.  LOVELY!!

For casual Commander, you don’t really need a way to untap it immediately.  Put it out there tapped and pass the turn.  All three of your opponents won’t want to risk angering you just to blow up an artifact that might get used on one of the other players.

Once it untaps, just let it sit there and keep 1 mana up for it.  It’s obviously a debilitating effect on whoever you use it on, but it’s often far more valuable as a deterrence.  No one wants to risk you nuking their hand
